title: Occurrence of PFAS in municipal drinking water: a participatory case study in London, UK
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, Advance Article

Globally, per- and poly-fluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) contamination has been reported in numerous environmental matrices, but data on their occurrence in drinking water within UK households remains limited.
